original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚军方与国安局挫败绑架图谋，逮捕收取20万奈拉赎金的嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚陆军部队与国家安全局（DSS）联合行动，在纳萨拉瓦州逮捕一名涉嫌绑架者，此人当时正试图向一名女性居民收取20万奈拉赎金。据称，嫌疑人Iliyasu曾威胁绑架该女子，除非她支付20万奈拉。此次逮捕依据情报报告，DSS于10月29日向军方通报了相关威胁。目前信息为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Akwaba in Eggon Local Government Area of Nasarawa State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚陆军与DSS联合行动逮捕一名涉嫌绑架者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Troops of the Nigerian Army, in collaboration with operatives of the Department of State Services (DSS), have arrested a suspected kidnapper

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人试图向一名女性居民收取20万奈拉赎金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: while attempting to collect a N200,000 ransom from a female resident in Nasarawa State

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指曾威胁绑架该女子以索取20万奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Iliyasu had allegedly threatened to abduct a woman unless she paid N200,000

key_facts.fact: 逮捕地点为纳萨拉瓦州Eggon地方政府区Akwaba
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: arrested at Akwaba in Eggon Local Government Area of the state

uncertainties: 嫌疑人威胁绑架的指控为据称，尚未经司法证实
